item.title: Codex-5.3 is not accessible
item.body:
Type: Bug Title: Selecting “Codex” in VS Code Copilot Chat consistently fails with 400 unsupported_api_for_model Date/time: 2026-03-15 (local time) Product: GitHub Copilot Chat (VS Code) Account type: Student Steps to reproduce: 1) Open GitHub Copilot Chat in VS Code 2) Switch the model/mode to “Codex” 3) Send any prompt Expected result: Copilot Chat returns a normal response. Actual result: The request fails with HTTP 400: {"error":{"message":"model \"gpt-5.3-codex\" is not accessible via the /chat/completions endpoint","code":"unsupported_api_for_model"}} Notes: - This is reproducible every time. - It happens both with and without an HTTP proxy. - Copilot Chat works in the default (non-Codex) mode. > > I was using systerm version, now change to user version. Everything works now!
> 
> I also have this question,how can I change to user version

go to official website and redownload. Make sure you download the user version. There is no need to uninstall system version. Then open,the user version, all the extension will be left. Except for copilot. It will remind you to reinstall. I'm a rookie in CS, and I don't know if there will be any residual files. But now I can use codex 5.3 and agent model of copilot.
